config.title: CRM
config.description: Run customizable relationship flows, send founders outreach, and group imported Zoho Mail into shared CRM boxes.

permissions.label: Read encrypted contacts and email history for your organizations
Create and update shared organization CRM records
Send an email, including founders outreach, only after you explicitly submit its compose form
Use encrypted organization OAuth credentials to import Zoho Mail after an explicit sync
Open a configured email-provider send link after an explicit click
Import a selected contacts CSV and export organization contacts
Tie the Gmail or Zoho Mail message you open to a contact after an explicit click in the ForkMesh browser extension
Share a contact sheet read-only with named ForkMesh users outside the organization
Read a contact's newest public Mastodon post from their own instance for the Mastodon last update column
Use the organization's Mastodon token to log toots it sent that mention a contact
For ForkMesh administrators, record which contacts have a ForkMesh account, pay, or are on a trial
Read a contact's Gravatar, and the picture and newest public posts of the Mastodon, Bluesky or GitHub account it names
